summary: Preflight exact workflow status questions against the complete cached run index.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Question retrieval intentionally sends at most eight evidence passages to the model
A synthetic fixture proved that a conflicting explicit status could exist only in the complete workflow index
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective explicitly authorizes continued accuracy and multi-content adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: The full-run preflight requires an explicit exact RFI or Submittal identifier and a status-oriented question.
A generic Email-thread status question remains limited to the bounded retrieved evidence because the workflow index does not infer semantic Email status.
The guard preserves ambiguity and does not determine chronology, revision precedence, authority or contractual correctness.
Synthetic offline validation does not establish construction accuracy or live-provider behavior.
